item.title: AI Mammogram Diagnosis Under Real-World Conditions: Two studies test Google's breast cancer detection models in clinics
item.description: Introduced in 2020, Google’s AI system for detecting breast cancer in mammograms still hasn't been used to diagnose current patients.

item.title: China Nixes Meta-Manus Tie-Up: State regulators block acquisition of an agentic startup headquarted in Singapore
item.description: China shut down Meta’s attempt to acquire agentic technology that originated within its borders, a blow to further technical interchange and investment between China and the U.S.

item.title: OpenAI Challenges Speech-to-Speech Leaders: RealTime API updates audio models that reason, transcribe, and translate
item.description: An update of OpenAI’s speech-to-speech model lets developers tune the tradeoff between speed and reasoning.

item.title: U.S. to Evaluate Upcoming Models: U.S. Government Will Test AI Models for National Security Risks, Other Hazards Prior to Release
item.description: The U.S. government said it will evaluate cutting-edge models before they’re available to the public, a sharp reversal of the White House’s earlier hands-off policy.

item.title: Speak With AI Andrew!: Andrew Ng built a voice-to-voice AI avatar shaped by his personality. You can use it to discuss whatever is on your mind.
item.description: We’ve been working on AI Andrew, an AI companion shaped by my personality.
